# Short 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
Short:Int32 value:Float32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The Short.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a Short, a 16-bit integer from -32768 to 32767. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A whole number that is too large keeps its lowest 16 bits, a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) and stops at -32768 or 32767 if it is outside. Use [SatShort](SatShort) to stop whole numbers at the limits as well.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Short(1000)
Print Short(40000)
Print Short(100000.0)
```

```text
1000
-25536
32767
```
